method: Three alternating fresh-process runs per host and mode; compiled variants before=old runtime/old source, compiler=new runtime/old source, after=new runtime/new source. Reference compares before/after. Node v24.15.0. Foreign Node jobs monitored before/every second during each run; Intel >=98% idle and no swap activity before each sample. All 30 final samples retained. Timing includes parsing/analysis/execution, excludes startup. RSS is process lifetime peak.
limitations: Mac reference RSS median rises 334.0 to 338.7 MiB; do not claim reference memory savings on Mac.
Compiler-only Mac RSS rises 284.6 to 306.7 MiB; the final program lowers it to 251.6 MiB.
Exploratory variants and their timing data are not mixed into this fixed final series.
Two additional private empty-identity checks passed on both hosts after the 1873-test broad run (32-test final focused rerun).
